results.content: Program.cs(1,19): error CS0103: The name 'VersionedApp' does not exist in the current context [VersionedApp.csproj]
CoreCompile executed and failed in Csc.
No GenerateVersionInfo target execution was recorded.

steps.message: CoreCompile ran and failed with CS0103 because Program.cs references VersionedApp.VersionInfo, but VersionInfo.cs was never generated before compilation. Looking at the project's target list, GenerateVersionInfo is declared with AfterTargets="Build" -- that only runs after the entire Build target (which itself depends on CoreCompile) finishes, so it can never produce the file in time for the same build's compile step. In fact, since CoreCompile fails, Build itself never completes, so GenerateVersionInfo never even executes at all in this run.

The chain is: CoreCompile compiled Program.cs before VersionInfo.cs existed, producing CS0103, because GenerateVersionInfo is hooked with AfterTargets="Build" and never runs early enough. Fix the hook with BeforeTargets="BeforeCompile" (or "CoreCompile"), and declare VersionInfo.cs in a top-level Compile item so it remains present on later evaluations when the incremental generation target is skipped.
